description.narrative: (i) Increasing access to finance to Mongolian SMEs; (ii) Diversifying funding source for an important IFC partner as well as a systemic bank;

The Project is to extend an 8-year subordinated loan of US$30 million to XacBank (the Bank) to help the Bank strengthen its tier-II capital and enable it to achieve its loan growth targets over the next five years. XacBank was established in October 2001 and has been an existing IFC client since 2002. The Bank seeks to aggressively grow its SME lending business over the next five years, and is thus in need of additional capital to make this possible.
